name: Kast best-case VFS-passive reused-index delivery program

requirements.statement: Current amichne/kast head is the sole tooling-state authority and the program rejects a stale target head.
The delivery definition is a typed Kotlin graph executed and verified through Gradle, not a prose backlog.
The task graph, module graph, process graph, gate graph, schemas, and traceability projections are deterministic.
Progress and completion derive only from proof-carrying receipts bound to the exact head and program fingerprint.
The default semantic runtime executes inside the existing IntelliJ process and existing open Project.
The default path starts no kast-indexer process, opens no second Project, imports no Gradle model, and causes no second indexing cycle.
The default install contains no private IDEA home, JBR, bundled IntelliJ platform, or semantic-runtime archive.
The CLI admits one compatible exact-root IDE endpoint and never falls back to runtime acquisition or process launch.
The MVP endpoint supports exactly workspace.inspect, symbol.discover, symbol.resolve, and symbol.describe.
Discovery candidates refine into exact selectors and selectors round-trip to the same declaration.
The normal hosted read path is VFS-passive and invokes no VFS refresh API or Gradle refresh/import API.
Hosted semantic reads use cancellable write-priority smart reads and reject dumb mode, disposal, cancellation, or movement.
Each Project admits at most one active Kast semantic read and no unbounded queue.
No hosted read action performs Files.walk, source-tree hashing, network access, blocking waits, or repository traversal.
Every accepted result is detached and revalidated against an IDE-visible epoch observed before and after the read.
The read-only plugin classpath contains no project-open, Gradle-import, VFS-refresh, source-write, topology-build, JDBC, or isolated-runtime implementation.
The endpoint binds canonical root, runtime identity, IDE build, Kotlin plugin build, plugin version, process ID, schema digests, capabilities, and Project lifecycle.
Unsupported operations and incompatible endpoints fail closed before semantic dispatch.
Project close, plugin unload, endpoint publication failure, and socket failure retire all endpoint artifacts without stale readiness.
Installed acceptance directly proves PID reuse, Project reuse, zero import, zero refresh, zero indexer process, zero runtime archive reads, selector exactness, and endpoint retirement.
The combined default control and plugin download is at most 80 MiB.
A detached clean checkout can reproduce the program projection and all required proof gates.
Exact-head CI rejects receipts, artifacts, commands, or projections produced for another revision.
An independent final review records every finding, resolves every valid finding, and reruns affected gates.
The final gate revalidates every original requirement point by point and only PASS is successful.
No task or machine-readable projection contains a writable completion flag or manually editable status.
VFS event storms create no per-event semantic jobs, no semantic work on the EDT, and no stale accepted result.
